original_benchmark.issue: Ultralytics select_device with the string cpu reset PyTorch from 4 to 8 threads during first flipped-image detection. The row correctly recorded 8, but the top-level old summary incorrectly hardcoded 4. No CUDA was initialized.

correction: Use torch.device('cpu') to take the Ultralytics device early-return without changing its global thread setting; assert torch.get_num_threads()==4 after detector construction and inference; report actual thread count. Add a verify-and-return guard for already-completed inference manifests.
benchmark_selection: Same first ordered input, selected before any target scoring; repeated only to verify the fixed CPU budget.
